process.name: Radar
process.narrative: In-memory flight recorder: Record is free, Dump writes one incident folder (trail, data items at failure, screenshot) only when something fails.

stage.name: Code Options
Configure Radar
stage.narrative: Set the incident root folder and ring capacity. Empty folder / zero capacity keep the defaults (%TEMP%\Radar, 50).

stage.name: Run Configure Radar
Record Event
stage.narrative: Append one entry to the ring (label + detail). No I/O; the oldest entry falls off past capacity.

stage.name: Run Record Event
Dump Incident
stage.narrative: Write the incident folder: trail, data items at failure, exception, screenshot. Clears the ring. Never throws; Dump Folder starts with ERROR: when the folder could not be written.

stage.name: Run Dump Incident
Get Trail
stage.narrative: Return the current ring as text, oldest first (inspection / tests).

stage.name: Run Get Trail
